subtitle: Master the patterns that create melody, harmony, and musical expression
heroDescription: Scales are organized sequences of notes that form the foundation of melody, harmony, and musical expression. They provide the raw material for composing, improvising, and understanding how music works. Master scales to unlock the full potential of the guitar fretboard and musical creativity.

whatAreScales.title: What Are Musical Scales?
whatAreScales.description: A musical scale is a sequence of notes arranged in ascending or descending order by pitch. Scales are defined by their interval patterns and determine the character and mood of music. Understanding scales is essential because they control:

columns.title: Melodic Foundation
items: Available notes for melodies and solos

scaleTypes.name: Major Scale
scaleTypes.description: The foundation of Western music. Bright, happy, and optimistic sound.

scaleTypes.name: Natural Minor
scaleTypes.description: Emotional and melancholic. The relative minor of the major scale.

scaleTypes.name: Major Pentatonic
scaleTypes.description: Five-note scale perfect for beginners. Easy to use and sounds great.

scaleTypes.name: Minor Pentatonic
scaleTypes.description: The most popular guitar scale. Essential for rock, blues, and solos.

scaleTypes.name: Blues Scale
scaleTypes.description: Minor pentatonic with added blue note. Perfect for blues and rock.

scaleTypes.name: Dorian Mode
scaleTypes.description: Minor scale with raised 6th. Jazz and folk favorite.

scaleTypes.name: Mixolydian Mode
scaleTypes.description: Major scale with flat 7th. Dominant and bluesy sound.

scaleTypes.name: Harmonic Minor
scaleTypes.description: Minor scale with raised 7th. Exotic, classical sound.

scaleTypes.name: Phrygian Mode
scaleTypes.description: Dark, exotic mode with Spanish/flamenco character. Minor with flat 2nd.

scaleTypes.name: Lydian Mode
scaleTypes.description: Bright, dreamy mode with raised 4th. Ethereal, floating quality.

scaleTypes.name: Locrian Mode
scaleTypes.description: The darkest mode with flat 2nd and flat 5th. Diminished, unstable quality.

scaleTypes.name: Melodic Minor
scaleTypes.description: Jazz foundation scale. Minor with raised 6th and 7th ascending.

scaleTypes.name: Whole Tone
scaleTypes.description: Symmetric scale of all whole steps. Dreamy, impressionistic sound.

scaleTypes.name: Chromatic
scaleTypes.description: All 12 notes in half steps. Technical foundation for all other scales.
